_spec: THE EDIT SURFACE. Everything in the kit that a person changes by hand lives here and nowhere else. engine/content.js generates review content from each plate's own slot table; this file overrides it, per asset, per slot. Precedence: override > family rule > role default.
_howToUse: A key is an asset id with no aspect and no hour: 'figures/big-number-l1', never 'figures/big-number-l1-16x9'.

`slots` sets text by the slot's published name. Run engine/audit.js --check after editing: rule 21 fails any slot name that does not exist on that plate, so a typo is caught rather than silently doing nothing.
`data` sets what engine/series.js draws — series, bars, steps, cycle, spark, low/high/mark.
`args` overrides what is passed to the plate author itself (row counts, layouts, treatments).
Every string is still checked against its slot's own maxChars. An override that does not fit is a failure, not a truncation you find later on screen.

_whatElseIsEditable.palette: design-tokens.json — the 13 material roles and the 9 ink roles, per hour. engine/port.js maps the legacy 8 roles onto them; that map is the whole recolour.
_whatElseIsEditable.proportion: design-tokens.json → proportion. One size number, everything else a ratio.
_whatElseIsEditable.poses: engine/kit-model.js → POSES. A pose is joint positions, not a redraw.
_whatElseIsEditable.rooms: engine/kit-model.js → rooms(). Shape lists plus an anchor height; the anchor width and the portrait window are derived.
_whatElseIsEditable.whichAssetsExist: engine/build.js → LIB. 270 entries, each an author plus args plus a seed.
_whatElseIsEditable.theStory: engine/content.js → STORY. One fictional filing drives every sample number, so a contact sheet reads as one story.
_whatElseIsEditable.renderers: engine/series.js — the six the plates name, plus linePath and bridge.

figures/big-number-l1._why: The one plate most likely to carry a real headline number, kept here as the worked example of an override.
